title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Nice Frozen Apple Berry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Seriously Nice Frozen Apple Berry from Doozy Vape Co. is a mouth-watering fusion of rich, tangy Raspberries and fresh, crisp Green Apples for a vape that’s clean, juicy and utterly delicious. Both flavours come together beautifully with a refreshing jolt of pure menthol on the exhale. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , box mod vapes and sub-ohm tanks .
